d:
The Thunder defeated the Kings, 125-103 tonight in Sacramento. Shai Gilgeous-Alexander finished with a team-high 37 points along with 4 three pointers and 2 rebounds for the Thunder, while Aday Mara tallied 16 points, 13 rebounds and 3 assists in the game. Darius Acuff Jr. recorded 26 points, 6 assists and 3 three pointers. The Thunder improve their record to 9-5 with the win, while the Kings fall to 1-12 for the season.
